info.title: avivashishta.com API
info.summary: Structured data about Avi Vashishta for agents and developers.
info.description:
Read-only JSON endpoints describing Avi Vashishta's profile, experience, skills and projects, plus a conversational endpoint that answers questions about his work.

**Authentication.** None. There is no API key, no OAuth flow and no signup. The one exception is `POST /api/v1/chat`, which is origin-locked rather than key-authenticated — see https://www.avivashishta.com/auth.md.

**Versioning.** The API is versioned in the URL path (`/api/v1`). Breaking changes ship under a new path segment (`/api/v2`); the previous version keeps working. Additive changes — new fields, new optional parameters, new endpoints — are made in place and are not breaking, so clients must ignore unknown fields.

**Deprecation policy.** A version scheduled for removal returns the `Deprecation` header (an HTTP date) and a `Sunset` header (RFC 8594) giving the date after which it stops responding, plus a `Link` header with `rel="deprecation"` pointing at the migration notes. A version is never sunset less than 180 days after the `Deprecation` header first appears.

**Rate limits.** Every response carries `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining`, `RateLimit-Reset` and `RateLimit-Policy`. Read endpoints allow 60 requests per IP per minute; the chat endpoint allows 10. A `429` includes `Retry-After`.

**Errors.** Every non-2xx response is an RFC 9457 problem detail with `application/problem+json`, carrying a stable machine-readable `code`.

get.description: Returns the complete structured profile: name, headline, summary, location and timezone, education, current role, full employment history, skills grouped by discipline, career highlights, availability for work, and canonical links. Use this to answer any factual question about who Avi is or what he has done.

post.summary: Ask a natural-language question about Avi
post.description:
Answers questions about Avi's work, skills, projects and background in prose. Responds with a Server-Sent Event stream of incremental text terminated by `data: [DONE]`.

This endpoint is origin-locked: the request must carry an `Origin` or `Referer` header beginning with `https://www.avivashishta.com` or `https://avivashishta.com`, otherwise it returns 403. Prefer `GET /profile` when you need facts rather than prose — it is cheaper, unrestricted, and returns typed data.

requestBody.description: The conversation so far, oldest turn first.

200.description: Server-Sent Event stream of incremental response text.

schema.description: SSE frames. Each `data:` line carries a text delta; the stream ends with `data: [DONE]`.

text/event-stream.example:
data: Avi is a fullstack developer
data:  at Dock.us.
data: [DONE]

get.description: Every published post on Learn (/blog), newest first: free roadmaps (type `resource`), the prompts behind builds, build write-ups and career notes. Each item has its page URL, a Markdown URL and, when it has one, the Instagram Reel it came with. Filter with `type`, search titles, descriptions and tags with `q`. Get the full text from /posts/{slug}.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Restrict to one post type. `resource` is the free roadmaps.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive text to match in the title, description or tags.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests permitted per window for the calling IP.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in the current window.

RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until the current window resets.

RateLimit-Policy.description: The rate limit policy in force.

BadRequest.description: The request was malformed or a parameter was invalid.

Forbidden.description: The Origin or Referer header is not an allowed origin.

MethodNotAllowed.description: The HTTP method is not supported by this endpoint.

RateLimited.description: Rate limit exceeded. Honour the Retry-After header.

UpstreamError.description: The upstream model provider failed. Usually transient; retry with backoff.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem detail. Branch on `code`, which is stable; `detail` is human-readable and may change.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation, including how to resolve it.

instance.description: The path that produced the error.

retryAfterSeconds.description: Present on 429: seconds until the limit resets.

parameter.description: Present on parameter errors: which parameter was wrong.

allowedValues.description: Present on parameter errors: the accepted values.

Location.description: Where Avi is based and how he works.

remote.description: Whether he works remotely with distributed teams.

Role.description: One position in Avi's employment history.

companyNote.description: Context about the company, such as its YC batch.

startDate.description: Month the role began, as YYYY-MM.

endDate.description: Month the role ended, or null if it is current.

summary.description: What he did in the role.

url.description: Live URL, or null if the project is not public.

repositoryUrl.description: Public source repository, or null if closed source.

availability.description: What kinds of work he is open to and how to start a conversation.

content.description: Message text. The final user message must be 500 characters or fewer.

label.description: The type as Learn shows it, for example Roadmap.

reel.description: The Instagram Reel the post came with.
